# Xero

Xero is a cloud-based accounting software for small businesses, providing invoicing, bank reconciliation, bookkeeping, and financial reporting in real time

Category: Finance. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/xero/.

## Actions

- **Get Connections**: List active xero connections.
- **Get Contacts**: Retrieve a list of contacts.
- **Get Quotes** (read-only): Retrieve a list of quotes.
- **Update Invoice**: Update an existing invoice.
